draft_notes.explanation: Simulate each marked path independently against the immutable input. Merge only disjoint path write sets, so marker scan order cannot alter the result. Infer the up/side frame from demonstrations among all eight perpendicular cardinal frames; factory ignores d4. The independent gate uses a forward/lateral finite-state walker while target source uses a nested horizontal scan. Both compare every demo exactly and require a unique query prediction without query labels.
draft_notes.order_independence_argument: In the native constructor, prior paths only change background or wall cells into colours2/3/4/6/8; no path writes0 or7. Every cell inspected by a later successful path must still be0 or7. Every path cell before writing is checked as0, either directly or when entering from the preceding step; obstacle hits are checked7. Therefore a successful native draw cannot depend on previous painted cells, and all accepted paths equal the isolated-input walks with disjoint writes. Later source markers reside on the bottom boundary, which no earlier upward path reads. Frozen-input simulation preserves accepted native drawings without reordering their mechanism.
draft_notes.limitations: Malformed or intersecting input-defined paths are rejected. Such collisions cannot belong to a successfully returned native draw. Explicit caller inputs containing unrelated ink beyond native0/6/7 are not guaranteed. Colour roles use the episode-wide palette.
